system.description:
Spend a Hope to deploy a compact
medical fabricator, trauma printer, or
emergency reconstruction tool.
You can create, reshape, reinforce, or
repair a object or material within Close
range, no larger than you.
This protocol is designed for medical,
survival, and emergency use. For
example, you can print a temporary
prosthetic support, seal a wound,
create a tool, stabilize damaged
cyberware, or shape synthetic tissue.
If you use this protocol to help a
creature act through injury, or a failing
system, they gain a +2 bonus to their
next action roll.
This protocol can’t create weapons,
complex machines, advanced
electronics, ammunition, valuable
goods, or permanent.cyberware.
